```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source("R/functions/plot_asfr_selected_areas.R")
source("R/functions/plot_asfr_selected_years.R")

fpaths <- list(asfr_lad_smooth = "data/processed/asfr_lad_smooth.rds",
               asfr_lad_raw = "data/processed/asfr_lad_raw.rds")


```

```{r}

asfr_lad_smooth <- readRDS(fpaths$asfr_lad_smooth)
asfr_lad_raw <- readRDS(fpaths$asfr_lad_raw)


```



```{r, echo=FALSE}

sel_cd <- "E12000007"
sel_yrs <- c(2002, 2008, 2015, 2021)

plot_asfr_selected_years(asfr_lad_raw, sel_cd, sel_yrs)
plot_asfr_selected_years(asfr_lad_smooth, sel_cd, sel_yrs)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

sel_cds <- c("E12000007", "E09000002", "E09000027", "E09000005")

plot_asfr_selected_areas(asfr_lad_smooth, sel_cds, sel_yr = 2002)
plot_asfr_selected_areas(asfr_lad_smooth, sel_cds, sel_yr = 2011)
plot_asfr_selected_areas(asfr_lad_smooth, sel_cds, sel_yr = 2021)

```
